hallo.text: Welcome to the GOOBYTHEKE. Prescription or advice?

optionen.text: What helps with a tummy ache?

text: From GOOUHBUS? Can anyone even read this? … Ah. 'Cheese sandwich'. That old rascal.
Here, the Gooby Drops. Three times a day, not on the furniture.

ratschlag.text: Less Nutella. — I know. I still say it every single time.

laden.text: Of course! But the drops are prescription only, sweetie.
